Connect your wheel, pedals, shifter, button boxes, and gamepad, then configure everything from inside the game.

This first release adds multi device controller support and native force feedback to OutRun 2006: Coast 2 Coast. No vJoy, external input mapper, or manual configuration editing is required.

## Setup and play

1. Download and extract the release into your OutRun 2006: Coast 2 Coast game folder.
2. Connect your controllers before launching the game.
3. Launch the game and open **Options**, then select **Controller**.
4. The controller setup overlay will open automatically.
5. Use **Quick Setup** to configure your controls.
6. Open **Force Feedback** to select your wheel, test its direction, and adjust its strength.

Direct drive wheel users should begin with a conservative torque setting and increase it gradually.

For advanced settings, tested hardware, troubleshooting, and complete instructions, see the [README](https://github.com/hyp36rmax/multi-device-input#readme).
